pages.label: Live Director
title: Live Director
Say the shoot. Watch the board fill.
Talk or type to Comfy Prime and the Shot Board builds as you go. Nothing renders until you press the button yourself.

pages.label: Graph Doctor
title: Graph Doctor
A broken graph in. A plain answer out.
Paste or drop a ComfyUI workflow. It is checked against the nodes this ComfyUI really has, and nothing changes until you say so.

pages.label: Hardware Fit
title: Hardware Fit
Your GPU. What really runs.
Every goal, family and recipe against your card and memory. Measured where we measured it, and labelled an estimate where we did not.

pages.label: LoRA Showcase
title: LoRA Showcase
You trained it. Now show it.
A/B proof, model card, trigger words, licence and base model, from the run's own record. A bundle to share yourself: nothing uploads.

pages.label: Motion
title: Motion
Words in. A body moving.
Make a character move, follow a performance, animate a portrait, lip-sync a clip, or capture motion into a rig. Only what ran on this machine is shown, with its numbers and its faults.

pages.label: Music
title: Music
One song. Every model on this machine.
Every render here came from the same original brief. Measured by machine and by Whisper. No person has listened yet.

pages.label: Pack Lab
title: Pack Lab
Try a node pack. Keep it away from your work.
Reviewed picks with their risks in plain sight, and a sandbox to load one in. Reviewed does not mean safe.

pages.label: Project File
title: Project File
A whole shoot. One file.
Graphs, seeds, model hashes and where to get each model, ready to reopen on another machine. Never weights, never your folders.

pages.label: Prove It
title: Prove It
Our render. Your machine.
Re-run the exact graph and seed here, then wipe between the two. What differs is listed, not hidden.

pages.label: Voices
title: Voices
One line. Every voice on this machine.
Each model read the same line. Whisper checked the words and a script checked level and length. No person has listened yet.
